name: @omvila/contracts
description: OMVILA HTTP API sözleşmesi (tek doğru kaynak)

scripts.lint: redocly lint openapi.yaml && spectral lint openapi.yaml --ruleset .spectral.yaml && python3 scripts/check_conventions.py openapi.yaml
scripts.breaking: git show origin/main:contracts/openapi.yaml > /tmp/openapi.base.yaml && oasdiff breaking /tmp/openapi.base.yaml openapi.yaml --fail-on ERR --severity-levels oasdiff-levels.txt
scripts.generate:dart: redocly bundle openapi.yaml -o dist/openapi.json && node scripts/dart-spec.mjs && openapi-generator-cli generate --generator-key dart && pnpm generate:dart:build
scripts.generate:dart:build: cd ../packages/api-client-dart && dart pub get && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
